stances_toward.note: Rival, cooling, confidence C. Not adversary: the government's declared aim is the group's submission to justice (an ultimatum of 25 Jun 2026, the surrender of four members on 17 Sep, no negotiation), and the Clan itself replied on 29 Jun that submission was 'inevitable' and the question was terms, asking for legal and personal security and inviting the United States and the United Kingdom into the process. Cooling because Petro had talks with the group in Doha since Sept 2025 with Qatar, Spain, Norway and Switzerland as mediators, and temporary location zones in Córdoba and Chocó (the Tierralta zone, planned for 25 Jun 2026, was postponed); in July Petro lifted the suspension of the extradition of the chief 'Chiquito Malo', and the new government rules out negotiation. Bond none. Gap: whether the Doha table was formally closed after 7 Aug was not found; the submission bill had not been filed by mid-September.

relations_to.summary: Ultimatum and surrender. On 25 Jun 2026 the president-elect told the armed groups to submit to the rule of law and ruled out negotiating with the Clan del Golfo; the Clan replied on 29 Jun that submission was inevitable and the debate was over its terms; on 17 Sep 2026 four members of the Juan de Dios Úsuga structure surrendered in Briceño (Antioquia) with an arsenal. The Tierralta (Córdoba) location zone planned for 25 Jun was postponed, and the submission bill promised since July had not been filed by mid-September.
